newsitem.title: USA: Vitro year loss 4.1 bln pesos vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Vitro year loss 4.1 bln pesos vs profit.

text.p: Vitro Sociedad Anonima said on Tuesday that it lost 4.1 billion pesos in 1996, in results that reflect the inclusion of results reported by Grupo Financiero Serfin, an unconsolidated, associated company.
Vitro on March 5 released 1996 results that excluded Grupo Financiero, which subsequently reported its results on March 18.
The loss reported Tuesday compared to a restated net income profit of 1.1 billion pesos for 1995.
Vitro's total assets stood at 26.7 billion pesos, compared with 41.1 billion pesos at the end of 1995.
The company attributed the decreases mainly to the divestiture of Anchor Glass Container Corp.
Vitro, based in Monterey, Mexico, makes glass products, aluminum cans and household goods.
